name: Colorful Peacock
description: The peacock is the king of birds. It has an erect crest, colorful wings, noble and elegant, and its tail is like a fan studded with gems when it opens its tail, which is gorgeous and eye-catching. In traditional culture, it is a symbol of auspiciousness. When a peacock opens its tail, it brings good fortune; when a peacock holds a flower in its mouth, it brings wealth and prosperity; when a peacock enters its nest, fortune comes; when a peacock dances, happiness falls from the sky! Due to the beautiful posture of the peacock, dancers used it as inspiration to create deeply rooted dance dramas such as "Peacock", "Sparrow Spirit" and "Bird Love".
